description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful 30A Home! * Luxury Home in Highland Parks* 2 Porches and Balcony!* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.1 miles (parking, restrooms and seasonal lifeguards)* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center!* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Brown Eyed Girls is a luxury 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath home in the Highland Parks community of Blue Mountain Beach, just off Hwy 30A. Only minutes from the beach access, this stunning home features a bright, open floor plan with premium hardwood flooring, spacious patios plus a balcony, and a chef’s kitchen with quartz counters, gas range, and custom hood. This house offers a king master bedroom that boasts a private balcony and en suite bath, with dual sinks and a spacious walk in shower with a rain shower head. Additionally, there’s a queen bedroom and a bedroom with twin over full bunks. There are wall-mounted flat screen TVs in all bedrooms, the living room, and even on the back porch. Relax outside on the shaded deck overlooking the quiet pond or stroll down to the pool pavilion for the world-class pool, viewing tower, grilling and entertainment! Then cool off with a stop at the Blue Mountain Beach Creamery. Have the vacation of a lifetime at Brown Eyed Girls!Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.The Bed Setup: 2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk*Parking only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*Area Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
